page.layout: One title page, all centred. Title lines at top; below them a woodcut device (engraving) with the motto "MILITIA BONAM MULTITAM" in a surrounding ring; below that the imprint: place, printer, and date. A handwritten signature sits at lower right and is not transcribed.

l.i: Triumphum philosophiæ, iurisprudentiæ, & medicinæ sacræ, itemq; sacrosanctæ theologiæ, quatenus illarum fundamenta ex Scriptura V. & N.T. colliguntur.

page.notes: Woodcut device between the author line and the imprint: an armoured horseman on a rearing horse, on a pedestal bearing the monogram "EK", inside an oval band reading "MILITIA BONAM MULTITAM" (partly cut off at the top corners of the band in the scan). Not transcribed as text beyond the motto. The handwritten "Joh. Conrad Caussenig D." at lower right is an owner's inscription, not printed, and is omitted. The "Scriptura V. & N.T." abbreviation is kept as printed. Long s has been normalised to plain s throughout.
